units.name: Department of Accounting and Operations Management
units.evidence: Current official department page names Accounting and Operations Management. Its PhD teaching list names Accounting only, so the department name alone does not establish a separate Operations doctorate.

sources.note: Current official BI name and eight PhD specialisation names; no named Operations/Management Science/Industrial Engineering specialisation.
Exact qualifying department title; explicit listed departmental PhD responsibility is Accounting only.
Data and Decision Science PhD specialisation is based in Department of Data Science and Analytics; Operations Research is a collaboration/research feature, not the formal specialisation name.

limitations: The currently advertised doctoral specialisations have no title-matching route on the pages read. Historical Ops-named doctoral routes and all current unit affiliations require further review before complete status.
One imported faculty doctorate remains discovery only.
